contract: Daily log files live at metadata/logs/daily/<UTC YYYY-MM-DD>.txt and hold one JSON object per line with string timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS', string source 'File.js:line', non-empty string message, levelName from LogLevel and the matching numeric level; the admin GET /api/logger-data returns currentDailyLogs as an oldest-first array of those records; starting the server loads today's file, drops unparsable lines (rewriting the file), keeps the newest seven daily files by default and appends new records; a non-admin is refused. The crash log is a separate file written only by the process-level fatal handler.
exceptions: force is not applicable: log files and the admin logger-data read have no force/override mode.
The crash log is not asserted: only the process-level uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers write a FATAL record, and no API can produce one without killing the server.

invariants.contract: Each line of metadata/logs/daily/<UTC date>.txt is one JSON object with string timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS', string source 'File.js:line', non-empty string message, a levelName from TRACE/DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR/FATAL/NOTE and the matching numeric level; GET /api/logger-data as root returns currentDailyLogs as an oldest-first array of records with that shape, and as the non-admin listener returns 403 with no records.

On start the manager loads today's existing daily file, keeps its valid JSON records (they are returned by /api/logger-data), removes unparsable lines by rewriting the file, then appends new records; with eleven daily files it removes the four oldest and keeps the seven newest (default loggerDailyLogsToKeep=7), and today's file is created/appended for new records.
